primary_events: one per security-cycle, shared across cohort memberships
trade_rules: all price-bearing conditions must permit high/low and open/close; regular empty/0 allowed; condition 12 allowed only AH/PRE; explicit stale/out-of-sequence/administrative conditions rejected
correction_rules: 7/8 original rows remain observable before later 11/10 notices; restore original fields for 1 from matching later 12 if uniquely reconstructable; otherwise unresolved. Notices are not new price signals. Later invalidation never erases an observed event.
first_touch_scope: first eligible observed provider-window touch; full-cycle overnight completeness is never asserted
forward_clock: wall clock; last eligible mark at/before target; no interpolation; stale/missing/gap marks censored
excursions: observed eligible prices from touch through cycle end, including zero at touch; retain gap/censoring flags
barrier_horizon: cycle end; gaps before first passage censor ordering; both barriers at same SIP timestamp are ambiguous
performance: gross observed price movement, not executable entry or trading P&L
statistics: descriptive pilot only, samples separate; repeated security/cycle observations are not independent trials
